items.title: SPX +1.79% at 7,737 first record close in 2 months + Dow +1.71% above 54,000 first ever
items.body: S&P 500 收 7,737.05 首次破 6/23 KOSPI 海啸后 6-2 前高、Dow 收 54,041 首次破 54K 心理位（+930 pts）。核心驱动：ISM Manufacturing PMI 55.6 highest since May 2022 + Semi rally broad broad chip Day 3 mean-reversion + Iran/Hormuz 缓和 macro tailwind + broad AI infra earnings（PLTR +29% blowout Q2 + AMD/ANET/ALAB/ENTG 池内 6 家 AMC 财报密集）。VIX +4.04% at 16.50 微涨 hedge signal 未 panic。

items.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI 55.6 in July 2026 - highest since May 2022 + Employment 52.8 first expansion in 33 months
items.body: ISM Manufacturing PMI 55.6 vs 6 月 53.3 是 May 2022 (55.9) 以来最高 + 连续 7 个月扩张。核心 sub-index：Production 58.5 (highest since Nov 2021 +6.3pt) + New Orders 56.7 (+0.7pt) + Employment 52.8 (+3.1pt first expansion in 33 months) + Backlogs 55.0 (+4.5pt)。Manufacturing sector 全线加速信号强、AI chip capex 需求端 macro tailwind confirm。

items.title: SPCX SpaceX 首次公开财报 rev $7.8B +92% + capex $18.37B 6x YoY 但 AH -8%

items.body: AMD 8/4 AMC Q2 CY26 财报：Rev $11.5B +50% YoY beat $11.3E / non-GAAP EPS $1.66 beat $1.61E / GAAP EPS $1.38 / Data Center Rev $6.7B +107% YoY 占 58% (EPYC + Instinct MI355X)。Q3 guide $12.7-13.3B beat 共识 $12.5B +1.6-6.4% (YoY +41% midpoint)。AH -8% 至 ~$477 三大原因：(1) Q3 guide midpoint $13.0B 超预期但 Data Center guide 未 broken out; (2) 7/22 Advancing AI Day 已 fully priced-in MI355X; (3) INTC +10.84% competitive concern。

items.title: ANET Q2 CY26 BLOWOUT BEAT: Rev $3.04B beat +7.4% + Q3 guide $3.3B beat +12% (biggest ever guide beat magnitude)

items.body: DigiTimes 8/4 报告：TSMC Q3 2026 CoWoS 先进封装产能 100% sold out（NVIDIA GB200/Blackwell + AMD MI355X + Apple M5 + AVGO custom silicon 前四大客户全 pre-allocated）。**N2 良率 first-pass >70% 是 TSMC 有史以来首次 first-pass yield 破 70% 关键 milestone**、Apple M5 Family + NVIDIA Rubin 首批 tape-out 良率超预期。TSM 8/4 +2.72% temperate rally vs SOXX +6.80%、Fab/代工板块 +2.90% 排名 sub-industry #22（最温和）。
